sections.title: Suggestions for improving FinVest (evidence-based)
sections.html: Insufficient data to support evidence-based suggestions (needs ≥60 trading days and ≥30 closed trades). Structural observations from the audit that do not depend on returns: (1) persist daily snapshots durably and schedule score_decision_outcomes.py in the workflow; (2) emit the true price date and flag stale-priced names (e.g. last price years old) instead of scoring them; (3) publish ADD/REDUCE/EXIT transitions — none were observed in the first snapshot.
